data.summary: I wrote intent/g1b/dev-plan.md with three ordered steps: the readyTicks state and tick hold in game.ts, drawReady rendering in render.ts, then tests and verification (unit and e2e smoke). Each step lists what it delivers and checkable done criteria. Assumptions a reader must know: Ready lasts 12 ticks, a direction pressed during Ready applies on the first tick after it, and the text sits at column 9, row 12. File names and test patterns come from the tech spec and were not checked against the code.

I added CAP-6 (Ready message at the start of each life) as a new file with criteria CAP-6.1 to CAP-6.5. They cover READY! showing at game start and after a life lost while lives remain, no READY! after the last life, pacman and ghosts held still during READY!, and movement resuming on the next step when it ends. A reader should not expect the Ready duration (the spec's assumed 12 ticks), the exact position or styling of the text, restart or pause behaviour during Ready, or direction keys pressed during Ready. I wrote no pointers and did not touch CAP-1 to CAP-5.
